DETAILREPORT.description: Steel Code Check Detail Report (DETAILREPORT). Generates a KDS 41 30 2022 steel design check report file; REPORT_TYPE selects whether the report is by section property or by member, which in turn drives which item list is used.

Argument.description: Request body for generating the steel design detail report.

REPORT_TYPE.description: Table Type. Case-insensitive. PROP = report by section property (uses SECTION_LIST); MEMB = report by member (uses ELEM_NO_LIST).

CURRENT_MODE.description: Report Mode. Case-insensitive. Selects the level of detail of the generated report.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export Path. Directory the report file is written to; concatenated with OUTPUT_NAME to form the full output path.

OUTPUT_NAME.description: Output File Name. Appended to EXPORT_PATH to form the full report file path.

ELEM_NO_LIST.description: [REPORT_TYPE=MEMB] Element Numbers. Required (must be assigned) when REPORT_TYPE is MEMB.

SECTION_LIST.description: [REPORT_TYPE=PROP] Section Numbers. Required (must be assigned) when REPORT_TYPE is PROP.
